jZy7mFJdbJEz.text: You can divide fractions by inverting the divisor (the fraction you are dividing by) and then multiplying

WYaSvHReq4Td.text: To find the fraction you need to do the following operation: $$\frac{-\frac{18}{7}}{-\frac{6}{5}} = \frac{-\frac{18}{7}}{-\frac{6}{5}} = \frac{-\frac{18}{7}}{-\frac{6}{5}} \times \frac{-5}{-6} \times \frac{7}{1} \times \frac{5}{6}$$

rRKJfkBGMzGT.text: This can be simplified to: $$\frac{\frac{18 \times 5 \times 7}{7 \times 6 \times 6}}{1}$$ Which can be simplified into: $$\frac{\frac{630}{126}}{1}$$ Which can be simplified into $$\frac{5}{\frac{21}{7}}$$
